en: A black-and-white image showing the ruins of a medieval stone castle surrounded by trees and foliage. The central structure features a tall, rectangular keep or tower with battlements, and adjacent to it are the remains of other stone buildings, including a wall with several window openings. There is a rustic wooden fence in the foreground and a path leading toward the ruins. The overall setting is lush and somewhat overgrown, indicating the location is not currently in use.
